newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa telecoms ambition helps share.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa telecoms ambition helps share.

text.p: The recent surge in the share prices of Inparsa and Sonae Industria is due to optimism over an increase in Inparsa's stake in Sonae Industria and its planned telecommunications activities, analysts said.
Inparsa raised its stake in Sonae Industria by about 10 percent to nearly 73 percent after a recent capital increase, and market operators said on Thursday it could acquire more shares.
"There is some expectation over a possible reinforcement of Inparsa's stake in Sonae Industria, and this explains the recent increase in the price of both stocks," one dealer said.
Shares of Inparsa hit an all-time high of 2,950 escudos on Thursday. Sonae Industria touched 2,239 escudos today. Inparsa was listed on the Lisbon bourse on March 21.
The rise of both stocks is not over yet and dealers said that Inparsa could hit 3,000 escudos and Sonae Industria 2,300 soon.
Dealers said Inparsa's expected involvement in a consortium bidding for the third mobile phone licence in Portugal was boosting the share price.
The Sonae group, in partnership with state utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal, Maxitel, Transgas and Gas de Portugal, will bid jointly for the third cellular phone licence.
Inparsa was created following the restructuring of Sonae Investimentos, part of the Sonae group, earlier this year.
"The rise in Inparsa is due to its plans to enter the telecommunications business," a dealer said.

Another said: "The rise of one company is dragging along the other, and in the case of Sonae Industria one has to factor in that this is a cyclical business and that this year has been a positive one for the company."
An analyst said: "We all know that the consortium that includes Sonae for the third cellular phone licence has strong possibilities to win."
He added: "The recent rises in Inparsa shares seem to be exaggerated and to incorporate some speculation."
Inparsa stood at 2,941 escudos, up 151, in volume of 154,735 at 1325 GMT and Sonae Industria traded at 2,223, up 51, in volume of 119,728.
